subject: Media Literacy
title: Retargeting and Remarketing
description: A short lesson to help you apply Retargeting and Remarketing.

hook.text: You put a jacket in your cart but didn't buy it. For the next two weeks, that jacket follows you everywhere online.

buildup.text: Retargeting shows ads for products you've already viewed, keeping them in your mind until you purchase.

discovery.text: It works because 97% of first-time website visitors leave without buying. Retargeting brings them back.

twist.text: The ads aren't reminders — they're psychological pressure. Seeing the item repeatedly increases purchase likelihood.

climax.text: Retargeting turns browsing into commitment. Looking at a product is the first step to owning it.

punchline.text: You didn't buy it. But the ad hasn't given up on you.

quiz.question: How does retargeting advertising work?
options: It shows random ads to new users
It shows ads for products you already viewed across other websites
It targets people in specific locations
